query: SELECT cp.id, cp.empresa, cp.valor, cp.vencimento FROM cobranca_planilha cp LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON UPPER(TRIM(ar.cliente)) = UPPER(TRIM(cp.empresa)) AND LEFT(ar.vencimentoData, 10) = cp.vencimento AND CAST(ar.valorLiquido AS DECIMAL(18,2)) = cp.valor AND ar.estado = 'EMITIDO' WHERE ar.id IS NULL;
